notes.title: Game update
notes.content:
Enemies:

 The boss battle has been completely reworked and the difficulty has been increased.
 Fixed slimes falling animation

UI:

 Fixed keyboard navigation inside the main menu
 Changed inventory space and added player stats
 Locked doors will now display a 'prompt'

Game:

 Health drops are now even more rare
 New items have been added (More to come soon)
- Floor map (Reveals the floor map)
- Potion of Health (Goes into your inventory and restores 20 HP on use)
- Boots of Levitation (Walk over holes)
 Fixed duplicate items appearing in the shop
 Fixed chests not opening correctly
 Added Bulgarian localization

notes.title: Game update
notes.content:
Player:
- The different hero falling animation is now rendering properly
- Dashing is now represented as the selected character avatar
- Hunter bow reworked
- Projectiles now fired from 'inside' the player to avoid wall collisions

Enemies:
- Bashee attacks, arrows from Skeleton Archers and swords from Skeleton Overlords no longer knockback the player
- Skeletons no longer 'hover' on top of holes when they fall
- Enemies that come out from barrels will no longer trap you in certain rooms
- Boss stages tweaked
- Added two enemies:
-- Small slime (Bounces around and hurts you on touch)
-- Zombat (Flies around and screams at you)

Game:
- Game version now available in the menu
- Health drops are now more rare (further balancing will be done)
- Hopefully fixed issue where player cannot move after restarting/moving to a new level. More testing needs to be done since the issue is not easy to reproduce.
- Fixed bug where players would get items in their inventory after opening up a chest
- Minor performance updates
- Increased number of enemies spawning

notes.title: Game update
notes.content:
Settings:
- Audio levels now no longer default to 0%
- Resolutions dropdown now works in-game
- Endless mode no longer switches windowed state

Enemies:
- Skeleton warriors no longer block the player and shots when dead

Gameplay:
- Store prices have been increased
- Wooden barrels now sound like barrels
- Dash challenge rooms now give better rewards
- Dashing now goes through enemies and projectiles
